comments.name: 末日先知
comments.content: 这就是我一直警告的！AI的泡沫迟早会破裂，这只是个开始，更深层次的危机还在后面。它带来的不是进步，而是失控和毁灭，对人类的异化已经不可避免。微软收缩算力，根本不是什么商业策略调整，是因为他们已经看到了AI不受控制的黑暗面正在蔓延。民主党摧毁数据中心？那不是摧毁，那是在试图阻止一场无法逆转的灾难蔓延。我们正在走向一个由算法和无尽数据统治的末日，人类的自由意志正在被腐蚀。睁开眼看看吧，未来的世界，危矣！

comments.name: GlobalCitizen_K
comments.content: Wow, 5.7 trillion wiped out? That's insane. It's kinda reminiscent of the dot-com bubble, but Goldman Sachs thinks it's more like '98, which is an interesting take. The whole AI shift from "building" to "application" that Morgan Stanley mentioned makes total sense, MS definitely pivoting, probably seeing the writing on the wall for raw infrastructure plays. And the US-Iran tension escalating, with US strikes and high-level talks, is quite concerning globally, let's hope for de-escalation rather than another major conflict. My peers back in the States are all buzzing about AI jobs and getting into tech, but the market seems so volatile right now. It makes you wonder about job security and long-term prospects, especially with these big tech players making such drastic moves like Microsoft reducing its cloud reliance on Oracle. Big changes are coming, everywhere. 🤔
